none: PAS NLM-E8A872: Roman Nummus possibly of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Fragment of Nummus, possibly of Gratian (367-383), possibly issue of 367-375. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: (--)TIANVS(--) Reverse description: Emperor left with standard and shield. Reverse inscription: (--)VIS(---). Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: Estimated as 20mm, Weight (actual): 0.65mm, die axis: 11
